locked.label: Canonical means one system, per field, per channel
locked.detail: Where two systems could write a field, one is named owner and the other is a reader. Ambiguity is what produces silent drift in the first place.

locked.label: Disputes go through brand registry with evidence
locked.detail: A contribution dispute is filed with the canonical asset, its PIM version history and the registry entitlement — never as a complaint about a change we noticed.

locked.label: Repairs are re-pushes, not edits
locked.detail: Nothing is fixed by hand in a marketplace console. The canonical record is corrected if it is wrong, then pushed — otherwise the next sync reintroduces the drift.

trigger.what: The Sync Integrity Monitor compared 214 listings field by field against the PIM and found 14 live values that no owning system had written.
One was the hero image on ASIN B0Y, replaced 41 hours ago by a marketplace catalogue contribution. Conversion on that listing is down 18% over the same window.
The Stranded Inventory Scanner added $18.4K across six blocks with no sellable listing behind them, and the two problems were pinned to one card because both are the catalogue failing quietly.
